installation_scope: Per-game, per-unit, exact-package transfer records; successful installation is separate from hardware gameplay/FPS acceptance.

cpu_frame_budget_summary.scope: Optimized Apple M5 Max CPU game update/render/audio only; excludes display, network and ESP32-P4 execution.

candidate_record_origin.scope: Immutable final spans candidate; installed flag is B only. A remains at its prior0.47 receipt.

tab5_build.scope: Frozen OS candidate only. Eleven game cartridges are independently bound to the staged manifest; the firmware-only build does not qualify that content bundle.
tab5_build.installation_scope: Installed means only the explicitly listed units; game package installations are separate.

hardware_acceptance.B: serial boot/health passed; physical inspection pending

per_unit_os_status.acceptance_scope: Exact OS readback, serial READY and10-second service health only; physical visuals, touch, audio and game frame cadence remain pending. Boot max131ms is not gameplay FPS.

follow_up_reviews.reviewer: Parent agent review, confirmed by card-game agent
follow_up_reviews.scope: Documentation-only concurrent Tide Maze library addition: main count12, Arcade entry and candidate paragraph; performance contract/link preserved. No runtime or skill semantics changed.
follow_up_reviews.validation_reused: Original five skill validations and registry/scaffold results remain unchanged; no runtime retest warranted for this documentation-only addition.

game_performance_standard.scope: Authoring/process guidance validated; this is not hardware frame-rate acceptance.

mouse_gesture_regression.implementation: 16-snapshot bounded mouse queue; adjacent held motions coalesce, press/release edges drain on normal service ticks. Only held motion changes position; button-up releases the last held position. Timing/audio unchanged.
validated: Complete SDL down/motion/up batch reaches real runner game in order
Same-frame tap retains press and release even if up coordinates differ
A changed button-up coordinate alone cannot invent held motion or a drag
Actual held motions reach their destination even when up coordinates differ
Overflow cancels rather than leaving held touch

cua_diagnostic.observation: CUA drag emitted DOWN raw595,264, then UP raw0,0 one millisecond later, followed by an unheld MOVE raw767,479. It emitted no held motion to the requested destination.
cua_diagnostic.status: Interactive desktop drag unverified because automation emitted a malformed gesture; actual SDL ordered-gesture tests pass. Physical finger drag remains pending.

mouse_gesture_regression.interactive_release_check: Root CUA verified three separate Rummy taps select the 10/J/Q of clubs; all three cards lifted/outlined and Play Cards enabled. No coordinate special case.

exact_pixel_proof.method: Independent per-pixel membership oracle against unmodified int rectangle inputs, plus existing draw/presentation tests.

riscv_assembly.finding: Old pixel loop reloads stride/pixels, multiplies row by stride, and maintains 64-bit loop counters. New pixel loop is a 16-bit store, 32-bit pointer increment, and conditional branch; all surface loads/address multiplication are outside it.

shared_raster_validation.limitation: Exact pixel output and reduced RV32 instruction work are verified; sustained physical-device frame rate remains unverified.
